E1002

Local module shadows reserved first-party or foreign root/name

What

Local module shadows reserved first-party or foreign root/name

Why

The registered jet rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E1002

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1002: tests/ui/core_reserved_shadow.stderr.

Error [E1002]: `core` is reserved for first-party or foreign packages
  --> tests/ui/core_reserved_shadow.jet:1:41
    |
  1 | use "./core_reserved_shadow/scoring" as core

 Why: `core`, `jet`, first-party ring names, and foreign-language roots can't be used for local modules
 Fix: rename the module or use it with `as other_name`
